messages.content:
The catalog API team found two bugs in the query strings our catalog client builds,
and both come from stringify in src/stringify.ts:

- Array values are joined with commas: `stringify({ tag: ["sale", "new"] })` gives
  `tag=sale%2Cnew`, so the catalog API applies one filter called "sale,new". Each
  element should be its own pair with the same key, in order (`tag=sale&tag=new`),
  and an empty array should write nothing.
- Spaces come out half encoded: `stringify({ q: "red running shoes" })` gives
  `q=red+running%20shoes`. The catalog API decodes query strings with
  decodeURIComponent, so the + stays a plus sign and the search finds nothing. A space
  should be written as %20 everywhere, in keys and in values.

withQuery and endpointUrl go through stringify, so they should pick up both fixes.
Everything else should keep working as it does now: parse, the encoding of other
characters, null and undefined values, and the order of the keys.
